description:
Advances: ancora.tasks

Stage: L5 (05a-stages-library.md). Plan run dir on epic ancora-yzu.

Deliverable:
Ancora.Output (the only stdout writer), Ancora.Output.Verdict (the only result= producer), gated/2 with the four-way classification ok/usage/env/internal, Ancora.Output.read_protocol/0 (the library constant all guidance quotes), one finding-line format [SEV] <subject> <code> <file> :: <message> for all families, [CONFIG] and Logger diagnostics pinned to stderr, no validate status= line anywhere, summary line checked subjects=<N> requirements=<N> errors=<E> warnings=<W>. Utilities task_args.ex and temp_name.ex port here.

Verification:
- Tests to pass: tagged_tests covering ancora.tasks.single_stdout_writer, verdict_grammar, no_result_leak, stderr_pinning, read_protocol_constant, finding_line_format
- Behaviors to demonstrate: ancora.tasks.scenario.forbidden_writer_test (static test parsing every lib/ file: no IO.puts/IO.write/IO.inspect/Mix.shell/Mix.Shell.IO outside output.ex and output/), result_never_leaks (stream_data property), config_diagnostic_on_stderr (unit half), no_validate_status_line (unit half); subprocess goldens land in L9
- Verification cadence:
  - Iteration tier: mix test --stale or named files plus mix spec.validate --root /Users/mz/src/ancora from specled_ex; no full suite mid-iteration
  - Final tier: the four common merge-gate commands run-until-green before IMPLEMENTED
  - Verifier tier: tagged tests for the ids above plus --stale only
- Standing bounce-class checks:
  - Production call site named for each new callable surface: gated/2 wraps every task in L9/L10; proving tests here are the unit emission-path tests
  - Fixture hygiene: no fixtures needed; tests async
  - Spec surfaces kept fresh for every touched callable surface
  - Every conditional clause covered (each gated/2 classification branch)
- Call-site Integration: every Mix task (L9, L10, L11, L12) runs inside Output.gated/2; proving tests here are per-branch unit tests, and L9 adds the subprocess goldens that exercise the contract as CI consumes it.

Out of Scope (files):
- lib/ancora/derive/**, lib/ancora/gate*, lib/mix/tasks/**
- lib/ancora/{parser,schema,index,decision_parser,finding,severity,config}* (read-only here)
Allowed touches (this stage may modify):
- lib/ancora/output.ex, lib/ancora/output/verdict.ex, lib/ancora/task_args.ex, lib/ancora/temp_name.ex
- test/ancora/output*_test.exs, test/ancora/static/forbidden_writer_test.exs, test/support/**
- NOTICE
- .spec/specs/ancora.tasks.spec.md (acknowledging edits to requirement/scenario blocks only; never weakening)

Out of Scope (intent):
- no second stdout writer anywhere, ever; no task emits its own verdict
- no validate status= line; no two-format finding output
- no Mix tasks in this stage

Merge gate:
- [ ] mix compile --warnings-as-errors
- [ ] mix test
- [ ] mix format --check-formatted
- [ ] mix deps.unlock --check-unused
- [ ] mix spec.validate --root /Users/mz/src/ancora passes (from specled_ex checkout)
- [ ] Scope check: diff touches only Allowed globs (mechanical)
- [ ] Auditor APPROVE comment on the ticket
